description: Treasure Hunter's Assistant dialogue at the temple for Crystal Ascendancy quest

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter's Assistant
dialogue_lines.text: &6You actually did it! I thought I'd never see you again.
&6Now that our celebrations are over, it's time for you to return home. Bring this tablet to the Treasure Hunter in his studies.
&6Lovely, you brought your &b<pokemon_name> &6with you. They'll help you get home in a jiffy!

actions.hover_text: Click to teleport back to the Treasure Hunter

dialogue_lines.text: &6It's a long journey back. Good luck, traveler!

actions.hover_text: Click to teleport back to the Treasure Hunter

dialogue_lines.text: &6That temple is messy business, you may want to set your spawn somewhere in case you end up sleeping with the fishes.

actions.text: The assistant glances nervously at the ominous temple entrance...

dialogue_lines.text: &6Bold of you to brave the temple without the help of your Pokemon. To each their own, best of luck!
&6It looks like you're all set to face the temple! Your &b<pokemon_name> &6will be helping you out.

actions.text: Return to the Treasure Hunter's Assistant near the temple to refresh this effect.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter's Assistant
dialogue_lines.text: &6Welcome back! Need another dose of water breathing?
&6Here you go! Good luck in there.
&6Still no Pokemon with Dive? You're a brave one!
